lyrics.en: Pink pig, pink pig, oink oink!
Pink bow, pink bow, tie a bow!
Pink rose, pink rose, sniff sniff, so sweet!
Pink donut, pink donut, yum yum yum!
Paint a pink pig, oink oink!

lyrics.en: Hug, hug! Soft bear! What color?
Pat pat! Soft puppy! What color?
Red and yellow, mix mix mix! Orange!
Blue and yellow, mix mix mix! Green!
Red and blue, mix mix mix! Purple!
Guess the color! What will it be?

words.zh: 红色 + 黄色 = 橙色
蓝色 + 黄色 = 绿色
红色 + 蓝色 = 紫色

title.zh: 同样的红，为什么不一样
